decisions.reason: Changing the crop of the Page 30 photo does not alter the document-wide layout, spacing, or background-treatment requirements.
The Page 30 photo crop does not change the Agua Arc identity or required brand assets.
The source changes a photo crop and has no effect on supplied tables or their integration.
The requested photo adjustment does not change Canva access, ownership, editability, or asset policy.
The Page 30 image crop is unrelated to hyperlink functionality in the saved proposal.
Showing the full tree in a photo does not modify narrative content, section order, or the unresolved Section 6 question.
The photo crop does not change the required PDF format, file count, export quality, or email submission constraints.
The source concerns a photo on Page 30, not the cover letter's page count, signature, or image relocation.
The source concerns the separate GreenLatinos RFQ proposal and does not change the TPEC proposal-design requirement.
Adjusting the crop within an existing Page 30 photo does not necessarily change the proposal's page-limit goal or reduction approach.
The photo edit is a revision item, but it does not change the allowed revision count or the trigger for performing final revisions.
The Page 30 crop request does not modify any draft, revision, submission, or deadline timing.
